items.name: Manchester Square-1 Day 2026

venue.name: Wythenshawe Forum
venue.address: Forum Centre, Simonsway, Wythenshawe, Manchester M22 5RX

items.information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**PLEASE NOTE:** This is a specialist competition. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. 

**PLEASE NOTE:** If there are no new competitors registered, we would remove tutorial and start competing at 9:30am.

The winner of Square-1 will be announced as the winner of the competition.

items.name: North Star Cubing Challenge MN 2026
items.information:
This is the 8th annual North Star Cubing Challenge competition in Minnesota!

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2lJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1f97c854b41905e0a0658611c178db646a55f666/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

items.name: DeNxNver 2026
items.information:
Welcome back for a third rendition of DeNxNver! This is a winter competition put on by Colorado Cubers.

All competitors must read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering.
 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcHB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--681018add857b2b9ddfd57914855080eeb87357a/Colorado%20Cubers%20Logo%20NT.png)

Even though on-the-spot registration is enabled, do not count on this! If the competition fills up, we won't be able to accept on-the-spot registrations, even if competitors do not show up. If you are able, we very much appreciate you registering in advance to save us time and effort, and save you some money!
